description: The file is a complete frontend HTML page for a database visualizer web application. It includes HTML structure, embedded CSS styles for layout and UI components, and JavaScript code for dynamic interactions such as loading database lists, tables, and data via API calls. It functions as the main user interface for browsing and viewing database contents.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds the HTML table structure for the data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cells, handles large content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on user click.
